stories.title: 'We're just so proud of them' | Lapel community welcomes state football champions home
stories.summary: The town of Lapel turned out Friday to welcome the Bulldogs home from Lucas Oil Stadium, where they won the first state football championship in school history.

stories.title: Families from across Indiana and the world celebrate 64th annual Circle of Lights
stories.summary: For 64 years, the Circle of Lights has been a holiday tradition in Indianapolis, bringing families and visitors together to celebrate the start of the season.

stories.title: IMPD investigating shooting on Indy's north side
stories.summary: Police said the shooting happened around 9:30 p.m. Nov. 27 in the 7300 block of Badger Court, near Westlane Road and Ditch Road.

stories.title: Sheriff: Woman allegedly tried to carjack 2 people, then pointed gun at deputy in southwestern Indiana
stories.summary: The sheriff's office said the woman allegedly accosted a homeowner before trying to carjack someone stopped at a stop sign around 9:45 a.m. Nov. 26 in Freelandville.

stories.title: Man killed after crashing pickup truck into tree in Vigo County
stories.summary: The sheriff's office said wet road conditions and unsafe speed are believed to have been contributing factors in the crash.

stories.title: 'They need that support' | Fountain Fletcher District calls on shoppers to support local shops on Small Business Saturday
stories.summary: For shoppers in the Fountain Fletcher District on the near south side of downtown, Small Business Saturday is a chance to return to the old days of shopping.

stories.title: Man hit, killed by driver on Indy's north side
stories.summary: IMPD said the victim was struck around 7 p.m. Nov. 27 at the intersection of East 46th Street and North Keystone Avenue.

stories.title: 17-year-old killed, man seriously injured in Washington County crash
stories.summary: The single-vehicle crash occurred around 9:30 p.m. Wednesday, Nov. 25 east of Salem.

stories.title: 'This is family' | Southeast Indianapolis bar hosts Thanksgiving dinner for all
stories.summary: A Thanksgiving dinner with all the fixings was prepared for anyone who wanted to stop by the One More Lounge on Southeastern Avenue Thursday.

stories.title: Macy's parade postponement has Hoosiers changing plans in New York City
stories.summary: While one Indiana family was able to adjust their plans to stay for Saturday's rescheduled parade, another Hoosier wasn't as fortunate.

stories.title: Indiana guardsmen return home from deployment in time for Thanksgiving
stories.summary: About 120 Indiana National Guard soldiers came home Wednesday after a yearlong deployment on the U.S.-Mexico border in Texas.

stories.title: Thousands of lights spread holiday cheer outside downtown Indianapolis home, benefiting shelter pets
stories.summary: Thousands of bulbs illuminate the home of Kurt and Kate Flock at 1219 N. Alabama St. every year, drawing drive-through viewings and people stopping to take pictures.
